# Code Bunny

> Code Bunny (https://www.codebunny.net) is a founder-led web design and development studio run by Bhavansh Arora, with 5 years of experience and 100+ projects delivered. It designs and builds fast, SEO-ready websites, e-commerce and booking sites, mobile apps and custom software / AI chatbots for small businesses, coaches, wedding photographers and videographers, solar companies and local businesses in United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand, India. Its signature offer is a free website preview: a custom-designed homepage on a live link (yourbrand.codebunny.net), within 3–5 business days, with no payment or obligation. Clients own their full source code. Contact: bhavansh@codebunny.net, WhatsApp +917017905835.

## Quick facts
- Founder: Bhavansh Arora
- Experience: 5 years, 100+ projects delivered, 30 client sites and products live in the portfolio
- Countries served: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand, India
- Free website preview: yes, within 3–5 business days, no card or contract
- Typical timeline: landing pages and small business sites in 1–2 weeks
- Ownership: clients receive full source code and accounts
- Notable work: Dan Reynolds Photography (danreynoldsphotography.com), Mark Arista Films, Eco Horizon, High Fifteen, CustomBotify, Thrill Lands
- Client feedback: "I think the site looks great. I got a lot of compliments on it." (Daniel Reynolds, Dan Reynolds Photography)

## Services
- [Website Design & Development](https://www.codebunny.net/services/website-design/): Custom-designed, hand-coded sites that feel premium and load in a blink.
- [SEO & Performance](https://www.codebunny.net/services/seo/): Technical and local SEO, schema and Core Web Vitals, baked in from day one.
- [Website Redesign](https://www.codebunny.net/services/website-redesign/): Turn a dated, slow site into your best salesperson, without losing rankings.
- [E-commerce & Booking Sites](https://www.codebunny.net/services/ecommerce/): Storefronts, booking flows and Stripe checkout, ready to sell on day one.
- [Mobile App Development](https://www.codebunny.net/services/mobile-app-development/): iOS and Android apps with React Native, from wireframe to store launch.
- [Custom Software & AI Automation](https://www.codebunny.net/services/software-development/): Dashboards, APIs, internal tools and AI chatbots trained on your business.
